subject.title: fix(plugins): keep openclaw chunks native in jiti

question: Should OpenClaw accept `nativeModules: ["openclaw"]` as the shared jiti boundary for plugin-loaded OpenClaw package chunks after the changelog entry is removed?
rationale: The dependency contract supports the option and the patch is narrow, but it deliberately changes the shared plugin-loader module graph for existing plugin execution paths.

options.title: Accept After Changelog Cleanup
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog edit, keep the runtime/test change, and land once exact-head checks are clean.

options.title: Require Packaged Marker Proof
options.body: Ask for a current packaged before/after marker run if source-level and Crabbox proof are not enough for this loader contract.

options.title: Pause Native Boundary
options.body: Hold the PR if any supported plugin contract intentionally depends on OpenClaw chunks being re-evaluated inside jiti.

recommendation.title: Accept After Changelog Cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog edit, keep the runtime/test change, and land once exact-head checks are clean.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent plugin-loader history and already provided the maintainer-sweep recommendation on this PR.
